There are seven contexts where Maori has ergative alingment in its marking: "weak imperatives", "clefting with 'he mea'", "actor emphatic", "neuter verbs" (aka statives), marking of subject in nominalizations, the question "Ko wai e?" and passive or "transitive 2" constructions.
